question: Under the Antyodaya Anna Yojana, rice is provided for rupees:
solution:
The correct answer is __**3 per kg**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Under the Antyodaya Anna Yojana**, rice is provided at a subsidized rate of **3 per kg**.
 
• The scheme aims to provide highly subsidized food to millions of the poorest families in India.
 
• It was launched by the Government of India in **December 2000**.
